**I can't confirm either way.** The tool output contains no tree-cover loss events for this property after 2020, but it also has no explicit "zero events" result. It's unclear whether the method found none or simply didn't return an event list.

What the output does show:
- Hansen data covers the whole property (100% valid) and runs annually through 2025, so a post-2020 loss of at least 0.5 ha could have been detected.
- About 285.6 ha (91.8%) of the 311.2 ha property was forest in 2020 (JRC).
- The run used a 2020-12-31 baseline and a corroboration rule
